Students engage in hands-on projects, fostering skills needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.
cmqwkgd4y03wmnwqoasvs34tf.entry: International applicants for the foreign-student quota send a sworn, notarised Turkish translation of their high-school diploma and transcript plus a passport copy by e-mail to foreign.students.unit@ankarabilim.edu.tr (stating the chosen department) or apply in person at the International Relations Coordination Office. After the documents are checked, suitable candidates receive a pre-acceptance letter and are invited to pay a deposit; the acceptance letter follows the deposit. cmqwkgd4y03wmnwqoasvs34tf.language: An English certificate is not required to apply. A certificate with at least TOEFL iBT 65 (3.5 new scale), PTE Academic 46, Cambridge C1 grade C / C2 grade C, Linguaskill General 140, Oxford Test of English Advanced 115 or Oxford Test of English 101, or ÖSYM e-TEP 74 exempts you from English prep (valid 2 years; state-university test centres; Home Edition not accepted). Without one, pass the university's prep-skip exam (7–10 September 2026); otherwise the English Preparatory School.
